idea-plugin.name: Lagoon Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Aesthetic teal-to-lavender theme with Dark and Light variants, inspired by gradient code-screenshot vibes. Port of the Lagoon theme for VS Code.

Includes a matching UI theme and editor color scheme for each variant. Enable it in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme.
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 — First JetBrains release: Lagoon Dark and Lagoon Light.
